names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 21 martie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 21 Μαρτίου, «Άγιος Ιάκωβος ο Ομολογητής ο Επίσκοπος», with the rank word, the epithet and the office left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's first heading for the Julian 21 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Свети Јаков, епископ и исповедник.“, with Свети left off, which is not a rank, and with both rank words епископ and исповедник left off as well. The heading gives no epithet and no see, and the entry says plainly that the see is not known, so the bare forename is what the source gives.

Read out of the heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 874, «Святитель Иаков Катанский (Сицилийский), епископ, исповедник», with the rank and grade words left off. The day's own line declines the forename and gives no see at all, «Прп. Иакова еп., исп». Both brackets are the calendar's own, Sicily set beside Catania, and are kept; the fold-key probe reports no folder holding this string. Before this row the folder held a Romanian, a Greek and a Serbian form and no Russian one.

death.note: doxologia.ro's life for the day: «în timpul luptătorilor de icoane, sub împăratul Constantin Copronim (740-775), a fost silit să se lepede de închinarea cinstitelor icoane». The reign is the interval the page prints; it gives no year of death.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 21 марта ст. ст. — «Прп. Иакова еп., исп (VIII-IX).»

attestations.note: **The calendar keeps a second day for him and the row does not move**: name page 874 and the life page both print «Дни памяти: 21 марта, 24 марта», and the day page that lists him is the 21 марта one, so 24 марта is recorded here and he does not render on it. The two days are three apart and neither is a style conversion of the other. **The rank is a disagreement inside one page**: the day's line abbreviates him «Прп.», venerable, while name page 874 heads him «Святитель Иаков Катанский (Сицилийский), епископ, исповедник» and the life is titled «Преподобный Иаков, епископ и исповедник» — the hierarch's title on the name page and the venerable's on the other two. The folder's existing `hierarch`, `bishop`, `confessor` and `monk` hold all of it and nothing is changed. The reading adds the house he came out of, the Studion monastery, and the manner of the pressure: he was repeatedly required to give up the veneration of the icons under «императора-иконоборца Константина V Копронима (741 - 775)», was held in prison, starved and tortured, and died in exile. The folder's bounds, 740–775, already hold that reign; the calendar's first year is 741 and nothing is changed for one year. The day's line gives the century as «(VIII-IX)», which is wider than the folder's interval and than its own life's reign, and is recorded here rather than taken. The day page prints no hymn for him.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 21 martie — «Sfântul Ierarh Iacob Mărturisitorul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 21ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιος Ιάκωβος ο Ομολογητής ο Επίσκοπος»

attestations.note: «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 21 Μαρτίου εκάστου έτους.» The page does not name his see either, and gives no year — where doxologia at least named Constantine Copronymus, saint.gr says only «στα χρόνια των εικονομάχων», in the years of the iconoclasts. So the corpus's interval, which rests on the Romanian page's reign, stands unchanged.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 03.04.2026 (21. март ст. ст.) — „Свети Јаков, епископ и исповедник.“

attestations.note: The day's first entry, on the same menologion day the Romanian and the Greek already keep in this folder, and the same bishop and confessor: the entry opens by saying that neither his birthplace nor the see he held is known, which is why both this folder's other rows print him with no see either. It adds the hunger, the prison and the mockery he bore from the iconoclasts. **One page disagreeing with itself, recorded and not resolved.** It names Copronymus as the emperor of the persecution and then closes „Живео и страдао у VII веку“ — lived and suffered in the seventh century, which the emperor it has just named rules out. This folder holds 740–775 from the other calendars, which is that emperor's reign; a sourced interval is neither narrowed nor widened on a reading, so nothing was touched, and the contradiction is recorded here. The stored form is the bare forename: Свети is not a rank, and епископ and исповедник are both ranks this folder's `types` carry. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the two hymns here are the other calendars'.

hymns.text: Îndreptător credinţei şi chip blândeţelor, învăţător înfrânârii te-a arătat pe tine, turmei tale, adevărul lucrurilor. Pentru aceasta ai dobândit cu smerenia cele înalte şi cu sărăcia cele bogate; Părinte Ierarhe Iacob, roagă pe Hristos Dumnezeu să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Ierarh Iacob Mărturisitorul

english.text: The truth of things revealed thee to thy flock as a rule of faith, an image of meekness and a teacher of abstinence; therefore thou hast won the heights by humility and riches by poverty. Father and hierarch James, entreat Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Ἐγκράτειας ἐκλάμψας Πάτερ Ἰάκωβε, ὡς Ἱεράρχης τοῦ Λόγου καὶ ἀληθὴς λειτουργός, ὠρθοτόμησας πιστῶς λόγον τὸν ἔνθεον οὗπερ τὴν χάριν βέβαιων, δι' ἀγώνων εὐαγῶν, ἐδίδαξας προσκυνεῖσθε, τὴν τοῦ Σωτῆρος Εἰκόνα, ὦ καὶ πρεσβεύεις ὑπὲρ πάντων ἠμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος πλ. α’, Τὸν συνάναρχον Λόγον, on the page of Άγιος Ιάκωβος ο Ομολογητής ο Επίσκοπος. It names him and names the icon of the Saviour, so it is his own and not a common. The page prints a Κάθισμα after it, which is not taken here; its «ἐδίδαξας προσκυνεῖσθε» for προσκυνεῖσθαι and «βέβαιων» for βεβαιῶν are the page's own readings and are copied as printed.

english.text: Shining with abstinence, O father James, as a hierarch of the Word and a true minister, thou didst faithfully divide aright the word of God, and confirming its grace by holy struggles thou didst teach that the icon of the Saviour be venerated; wherefore thou dost intercede for us all.
